description: Attach external evidence to an organization Hub session: TXT, Markdown, CSV, JSON, text PDF or DOCX, up to 10 MB. Send user-provided file bytes as base64. Uploading again creates another source; list sources after an uncertain response before retrying.

data_base64.description: Raw file bytes encoded as standard base64; never a server path or URL.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.
